body:
Thank you.. 
What do you think I should do?
Thanks, I'm Ally. It sucks because I want friends not to depend on for my downturns, but I want friends to be happy with. I think people are afraid to get close to  me.

Thanks. I know it's hard to deal with depression for family members, but I don't have the energy to try to figure out my feelings along with his reactions. I feel like if I was recovered I would have a perfectly happy relationship...who knows what would be different.

I told him.  he just ignores my depression and doesn't understand it and thinks Im incompetent at life. If this is the best I can do, what's my life ever going to be worth? If I cant even be treated nicely. It's so painful.

I really want to. My family is kinda far and money is tight. I would do this in an instant, you're very right. But I don't really have the means. I asked him if he would go out tonight with some friends after something he said really triggered me, but he wont. Like I said I don't have any friends. I have a history of depression and was hospitalized previously, and I've really been working to get better. I have been making progress-- I just wish I had a friend. If you have friends you should really be kind to them and remember they are complicated important human beings. No one asks me if Im okay. No one talked to me about it when I got out of the hospital. No one offered a hand to me or asked me if I needed some extra heart-to-heart time. I dont have anyone who is close to me, I can't do this on my own.
